summary.text: Samuel Vilchez Santiago is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 43 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Jorge Malavet in a race with no incumbent.
He is the chair of the Orange County Democratic Party and a senior manager at ActBlue, and he won the August 18 Democratic primary over Daisy Morales.

paragraphs.text: Samuel Vilchez Santiago earned an associate degree from Valencia College in 2015, a bachelor's degree from Princeton University in 2019 and a graduate degree from the University of Oxford in 2023.

In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign described him as born in Venezuela and arriving in the United States as a political refugee at age 13, and as the valedictorian of Colonial High School and the first person in his family to attend college in the United States.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as Florida campaign manager at All Voting is Local, nonprofit management, a Google fellowship, a diversity and inclusion fellowship at Hillary for America, and campaign manager for Johanna Lopez for Orange County School Board.
In his survey responses he said he serves as Chair of the Orange County Democratic Party and as a Senior Manager at ActBlue.

His survey responses name lowering costs as his top priority, including closing Florida's Medicaid coverage gap, addressing the property insurance crisis and increasing investment in affordable housing.
